Coverage?
Line coverage
Percentage of instrumented source lines executed by the test suite.
Heat map
Expand a file to see per-line hit counts. Color intensity shows how hot each line is relative to the file's max.
Hottest files
Files with the highest peak hit counts — your inner loops and performance-critical code.
CT audit
Hot lines marked TODO(ct) — code on potentially secret data that needs constant-time hardening.
Fragile coverage
Files where every covered line is hit at most twice, suggesting thin test coverage.

Mutation Testing?
Kill rate
Percentage of mutants detected by the test suite. Higher is better.
Caught
Mutants that caused a test failure.
Missed (survivors)
Mutants that passed all tests — potential gaps in test coverage.
Timeout
Mutants where tests took too long. Treated as caught.
Unviable
Mutations that failed to compile. Not counted in the kill rate.
